title: 第1739章 军团的第一次试探第1738章 极北冰原的防御
content_zh:
极北冰原外围，血祭军团前锋部队在暴风雪中全速行军。
前锋统领名唤血牙，源尊初期修为，血祭法则与风系法则双修，融合度接近四成。
他的面容在血祭法则的长期侵蚀下，已不太像正常修士，皮肤呈灰白色，颧骨和眉骨异常突出，眼眶深陷，瞳孔是两点暗红光芒。
背后没有骨翼，但肩胛骨的位置突出两根极长骨刺，骨刺表面刻满了密密麻麻的血祭法则纹路。
那是他在远古大战时期，献祭了自己的双翼换取的战力提升，骨刺是他剩下的唯一飞行器官。
他身后的百余名前锋战士全部是源皇巅峰修为，队列整齐得像是用尺子量过，每个人的步伐频率和间距完全一致。
血祭军团的军纪在邪神军团中以严苛着称。
战士从被选入军团的那一刻起，就被血祭法则抹去了大部分个人意志，只剩战斗本能和对邪神神王的绝对服从。
上千万年的休眠没有削弱这种服从，反而让它在漫长的时间中，凝固成了一种条件反射式的本能。
血牙在进入极北冰原范围后忽然抬手，全军在一息之内同时停下。
他感应到了前方冰裂隙区边缘传来的微弱法则波动。
是百战域气血法则的波动。
气血法则是百战域修士的标志性法则，以肉身气血为根基，在极寒环境中会产生细微的热量辐射，热量辐射在暴风雪中会被风系法则捕捉到。
“有埋伏。气血法则的波动，数量至少数十，修为全部源皇以上。
冰裂隙区两侧各有一批，埋伏阵型是标准的关门打狗。”
血牙的声音干涩，“关门打狗的前提是猎物进笼。既然猎物已知道笼子的位置，就不用进笼了。”
他从储物骨戒中取出一枚暗红色的血祭阵盘。
阵盘正面刻着血祭法则的献祭符文，背面嵌着一块远古大战时期封存至今的血祭结晶。
他将阵盘激活，暗红色的血祭法则光纹从阵盘中涌出，在暴风雪中凝聚成一道高达百丈的血色虚影。
虚影的形态是一尊无头血祭战神。

远古大战时期血祭军团的攻城傀儡，以献祭百名血祭战士的鲜血为代价召唤，战力相当于源尊中期。
“无头战神撞开冰裂隙区的入口，把埋伏的人逼出来。
全军在冰裂隙区外围展开，等他们被无头战神逼出来后，分三路围杀。”
血牙下达完命令后将血祭阵盘抛向空中，阵盘在空中急速旋转，无头战神虚影从阵盘中大步踏出，每一步踩在冻土上都留下一个燃烧着暗红血焰的脚印。
它手中握着一柄由血祭法则凝聚而成的巨斧，斧刃长达数十丈，斧身表面流转着血色光纹。
无头战神举起巨斧朝冰裂隙区的入口一斧劈下，巨斧砸在冻土层上，将入口两侧的冰壁，劈出了数道深达十余丈的裂缝。
裂缝中涌出的是被血祭法则高温瞬间融化的冰蒸汽。
蒸汽在暴风雪中凝成白雾，又被风雪撕成碎片。
项天齐从冰裂隙区侧翼的一块巨冰后方一跃而出，双拳上的暗金神血光膜，在暴风雪中亮得刺眼。
他没有任何废话，整个人化作一颗由纯粹肉身之力，驱动的暗金炮弹，朝无头战神的胸口撞了过去。
拳头砸在无头战神胸口的血祭法则护甲上，护甲表面的血色光纹，在巨力冲击下剧烈凹陷，凹陷边缘蔓延出无数蛛网裂纹。
但无头战神没有痛觉，它低头用不存在的头颅看了项天齐一眼，然后挥动巨斧横斩而来。
项天齐凌空翻身避开斧刃，斧刃带起的血祭法则冲击波擦过他的后背，百战域冰原战甲的后背护板，在冲击波中被撕开了一道口子。
阎的暗影陷阱在同一时间触发。
三十六道影刃从冰裂隙区底部的暗影裂缝中，同时射出，这次的目标是他身后的百余名血祭军团前锋战士。
影刃在暗影法则的加持下精准命中每个战士脚下的阴影。
血祭法则以献祭神血为根基，神血与影子之间存在微弱的法则连接。
阎在研究铁骨云带回来的邪神阵盘碎片时，发现了这个弱点，他布置的暗影陷阱，针对的不是战士本人，而是他们脚下的影子。
影刃刺入影子的瞬间，血祭军团前锋战士的队列中，同时响起了数十声短促闷哼。
影子被影刃钉住的战士，体内的血祭法则运转出现了瞬间的凝滞。

影子与神血之间的连接被暗影法则强行切断，血祭法则失去了献祭神血的根基，运转效率骤降。
“现在！”项天齐在空中翻身的同时暴喝一声。
content_en:
On the outskirts of the Far North Icefield, the vanguard of the Blood Sacrifice Legion marched at full speed in the snowstorm.
The leader of the vanguard is called Blood Fang. He is in the early stage of Yuanzun's cultivation. He has cultivated both the Blood Sacrifice Law and the Wind Law, and his fusion degree is close to 40%.
Under the long-term erosion of the Blood Sacrifice Law, his face no longer looked like a normal monk. His skin was gray-white, his cheekbones and brow bones were unusually prominent, his eye sockets were sunken, and his pupils were two points of dark red light.
There are no bone wings on the back, but two extremely long bone spurs protrude from the shoulder blades, and the surface of the bone spurs is covered with dense patterns of the Blood Sacrifice Law.
It was during the ancient war that he sacrificed his own wings in exchange for an increase in combat power. The bone spurs were the only flying organ he had left.
The more than a hundred forward warriors behind him were all at the peak of the Origin Emperor's cultivation. The queue was as neat as if measured with a ruler, and the frequency and spacing of everyone's steps were exactly the same.
The military discipline of the Blood Sacrifice Legion is famous among the Evil God Legion for being strict.
From the moment a warrior is selected into the legion, most of his personal will is wiped out by the law of blood sacrifice, leaving only his fighting instinct and absolute obedience to the evil god and king.
Tens of millions of years of dormancy did not weaken this obedience, but instead solidified it into a conditioned reflex instinct over a long period of time.
Bloody Fang suddenly raised his hand after entering the extreme northern ice field, and the entire army stopped at the same time within a breath.
He sensed the weak law fluctuations coming from the edge of the ice crevice area ahead.
It is the fluctuation of the Qi and Blood Law of Baizhan Domain.
The law of qi and blood is the signature law of the monks in the Baizhan Domain. It is based on the qi and blood of the physical body. In extremely cold environments, subtle heat radiation will be generated. The heat radiation will be captured by the wind law in a snowstorm.
"There is an ambush. There are at least dozens of fluctuations in the law of qi and blood, and all of them have cultivation levels above the Origin Emperor.
There are a group on each side of the ice crevasse area, and the ambush formation is a standard dog-fighting with the door closed. "
Xueya's voice was dry, "The prerequisite for hunting a dog with a closed door is that the prey enters the cage. Since the prey already knows the location of the cage, there is no need to enter the cage."
He took out a dark red blood sacrifice array disk from the storage bone ring.
The front of the array plate is engraved with the sacrificial runes of the blood sacrifice law, and the back is embedded with a piece of blood sacrifice crystal sealed up to this day during the ancient war.
He activated the formation disk, and the dark red light patterns of the Blood Sacrifice Law poured out from the formation disk, condensing into a bloody shadow a hundred feet high in the snowstorm.
The form of the phantom is a headless blood-sacrifice war god.
During the ancient war, the siege puppets of the Blood Sacrifice Legion were summoned at the cost of sacrificing the blood of hundreds of Blood Sacrifice warriors. Their combat power was equivalent to that of the mid-stage Yuan Zun.
"The Headless God of War broke open the entrance to the ice crevice area and forced the ambushers out.
The entire army spread out outside the ice crevice area. After they were forced out by the Headless God of War, they were surrounded and killed in three groups. "
After giving the order, Xueya threw the Blood Sacrifice Array into the air. The array rotated rapidly in the air. The headless shadow of the God of War strode out from the array. Every step he took on the frozen soil left a footprint burning with dark red blood flames.
In its hand, it held a giant ax condensed by the laws of blood sacrifice. The ax blade was dozens of feet long, and blood-colored light patterns flowed on the surface of the ax body.
The headless God of War raised his giant ax and struck it at the entrance of the ice crevice area. The giant ax hit the frozen soil and split the ice walls on both sides of the entrance, creating several cracks more than ten feet deep.
What gushes out from the cracks is ice steam that is instantly melted by the high temperature of the Blood Sacrifice Law.
The steam condensed into white mist in the blizzard, and was torn into pieces by the wind and snow.
Xiang Tianqi jumped out from behind a giant piece of ice on the flank of the ice crevasse. The dark gold blood film on his fists was dazzling in the snowstorm.
He didn't have any nonsense, and his whole body turned into a dark gold cannonball driven by pure physical power, and crashed into the chest of the headless God of War.
His fist hit the Blood Sacrifice Law Armor on the chest of the Headless God of War. The blood-colored light patterns on the armor's surface dented violently under the huge impact, and countless spider web cracks spread out from the edge of the dent.
But the headless God of War couldn't feel pain. He lowered his head and looked at it with his non-existent head.Xiang Tianqi glanced at him, then swung his giant ax and slashed at him.
Xiang Tianqi turned over in the air to avoid the ax blade. The shock wave of the Blood Sacrifice Law brought by the ax blade brushed his back, and the back plate of the Hundred Battlefield Icefield Armor was torn open in the shock wave.
Yan's Shadow Trap triggers at the same time.
Thirty-six shadow blades shot out from the shadow cracks at the bottom of the ice crevice area at the same time. This time, the target was the more than a hundred vanguard soldiers of the Blood Sacrifice Legion behind him.
With the blessing of the law of shadow, the shadow blade accurately hits the shadow at the feet of each warrior.
The law of blood sacrifice is based on sacrificing divine blood, and there is a weak legal connection between divine blood and shadow.
Yan discovered this weakness when he was studying the fragments of the Evil God Formation Disk brought back by Tieguyun. The shadow trap he set was not aimed at the warriors themselves, but at the shadows under their feet.
The moment the shadow blade pierced into the shadow, dozens of short muffled groans sounded simultaneously in the queue of the Blood Sacrifice Legion's vanguard warriors.
The warrior's shadow was pinned by the shadow blade, and the operation of the Blood Sacrifice Law in his body was momentarily stagnant.
The connection between the shadow and the divine blood was forcibly cut off by the Shadow Law. The Blood Sacrifice Law lost the foundation of sacrificing the divine blood, and its operating efficiency plummeted.
"Now!" Xiang Tianqi shouted while turning over in the air.
